packageRules.description: The Python runtime is capped by binary-wheel availability of native dependencies (ortools has no cp315 wheels). PR #3 raised it to 3.15 without CI and broke install. setup-python in workflows resolves as actions/python-versions (Renovate #197 slipped past the first rule). Bumps need manual approval and a green install/test run; keep .python-version, CI and Dockerfiles in sync (tests/unit/repo_scripts/test_python_runtime_pins.py).
